beronia-reserva:
Beronia Reserva from Rioja, showing aromas of cedar, dark berries, and crushed vanilla with notes of mocha and dried herbs from extended oak ageing, structured yet approachable with fine-grained tannins and a long finish from 18 months in Beronia's mixed oak barrels plus 18 months in bottle, made only in stronger vintages.

Tasting Notes
Aromas of cedar, dark berries, and crushed vanilla on the nose, with notes of mocha and dried herbs from the extended oak ageing. Structured yet approachable on the palate with fine-grained tannins and a long finish. A contemporary-styled Reserva full of berry fruit and subtle spice. Built from a selection of the best Tempranillo with Graciano and Mazuelo, and made only in stronger vintages.

Quick Facts

  • Grapes: Tempranillo, Graciano, Mazuelo
  • Origin: Spain, Rioja (produced only in exceptional vintages)
  • Style: Reserva, 18 months in mixed oak barrels plus 18 months in bottle
  • Winemaking: Beronia's signature mixed oak barrels (American staves, French ends), Reserva selection

Food Pairing
Roasted lamb, game, braised meats, and aged Manchego.

Serving
Serve at 16 to 18°C. Open 20 minutes before serving. Will age for 8 to 10 years.

About the Producer
Beronia is a celebrated Rioja winery founded in 1973 and part of the González Byass family since 1982, renowned for its innovative mixed oak barrels and consistently elegant Rioja style.
glenfiddich-special-reserve-single-malt-:
With a unique freshness from the same Highland spring water we’ve used since 1887, its distinctive fruitiness comes from the high cut point William Grant always insisted upon.

Carefully matured in the finest American oak and European oak sherry casks for at least 12 years, it is mellowed in oak marrying tuns to create its sweet and subtle oak flavours.

Awards & Press Review

GOLD MEDAL: International Spirits Challenge
MASTER AWARD: Scottish Whisky Masters

Tasting's Notes

Golden color. Distinctively fresh and fruity with a hint of pear. Beautifully crafted and delicately balanced. Characteristic sweet, fruity notes. Develops into butterscotch, cream, malt and subtle oak flavours.

Country & Region

Scotland
plasencia-robusto-reserva-original:
The Plasencia family has been growing tobacco and making cigars for over five generations. Making many popular bands like Rocky Patel, Gurkha, & Romeo y Julieta, the chances you tasted a cigar or tobacco grown by the Plasencia's is very likely. The Plasencia's decided to create their own super premium line that showcase their exception skill in cigar making with a handful of premium offerings.

Cigar Details & Composition

Shape: Robusto

Wrapper: Nicaraguan Habano
Filler: Nicaragua 
Binder: Nicaragua 

Tasting Notes

Smoking Time (Average): 45-60 Minutes

Plasencia Reserva Original has the very same taste that captivated the Europeans more than five centuries ago, when they arrived in the New World. It features notes of nuts, fruits, and caramel with delicate nuances of marzipan and final hints of cedar.

Country & Region

Nicaragua.

Occasion & Pairing

Whisky, Port Wine, Cognac, Red wine.
hendricks-gin:
Hendrick’s is an unusual Scottish gin created from eleven fine botanicals. The curious, yet marvellous, infusions of rose & cucumber imbue our spirit with its uniquely balanced flavour resulting in an unimpeachably smooth and distinct gin.

Awards & Press Review 

SILVER MEDAL: International Wine & Spirit Competition
GOLD MEDAL: The Gin Masters
MASTER AWARD: The Global Design Masters

Tasting's Notes

Creamy aromas right off the bat, with a little zesty citrus, juniper, rose petal jelly and cucumber. Astoundingly fresh notes on the palate of cucumber with juniper, oak, a touch more citrus and vanilla. Creamy and savoury.

Country & Region

Scotland
